name: palomar
label: Palomar Mountain (generic flat California site for the relocated ISI, baselines to 1 km)
sources: Palomar Observatory site coordinates (200-inch dome): 33.356 N, 116.865 W, 1712 m
notes: Stands in for any flat California site the ISI trucks could be driven to; only the latitude matters for the uv tracks, and the baselines are set per night by the campaigns' schedules (3 m to 1 km).
assumptions: the site itself (the user's suggestion; Mt. Wilson's own layout allows ~70 m)
